name: Regional workshop
picture_2050: Soy, maize and fishmeal stay ample and cheap on average, as in the published 2035 baseline. Several Asian countries build fermentation capacity and trade under shared or mutually recognised approvals. Vietnam uses a working new-food route and open pilot plants to specialise: contract fermentation for regional brands, textured and fungal food ingredients.
soybean_meal_need_2050_mt_indicative: 7.0 to 10.4 (S-EFF to S-BASE; depends on the efficiency programme)
where_vietnam_competes: Contract and tolling fermentation; textured plant protein; koji and fungal foods; high-value precision-fermentation ingredients after mid-2030s patent expiries
hubs_active_2050: Ho Chi Minh City with Dong Nai; Tay Ninh sugar hub; Mekong river belt
early_signposts: ASEAN reliance or mutual recognition of novel-food approvals; Thai, Indian or Korean plants exporting in the region; fishmeal below USD 1,800 per t for a year; China soybean imports below 100 Mt
what_vietnam_decides: Without a new-food route and open pilot capacity Vietnam lands in Scenario B inside the same external world
notes: Qualitative scenario; soybean-meal ranges are indicative mappings to chapter 22 model scenarios, not model runs.

name: Comfortable price-taker
picture_2050: Imported protein stays cheap and Chinese scale sets the price of every fermentation product in the region. Vietnam imports soybean meal and Chinese yeast, bacterial and textured proteins. Domestic alternative protein stays at chay processing, tofu and a few feed-additive lines. Feed mills gain from cheap inputs; the country stays exposed to any later shock.
where_vietnam_competes: Fresh and customised textured protein; local fungal foods
where_vietnam_loses: Tolling, precision fermentation, sugar exports to domestic fermenters
hubs_active_2050: Ho Chi Minh City with Dong Nai (small)
early_signposts: Imports of yeast and protein preparations from China growing above 20% a year; three or more Chinese single-cell or mycoprotein plants above 20 kt a year commissioned by 2030; non-Chinese Asian pilot plants underused or closing
what_vietnam_decides: Efficiency, a protein statistic and quality testing still pay; a hedge against later shocks is the main policy question

name: Security build-out
name_vi: Xây dựng an ninh nguồn đạm
picture_2050: Repeated fishmeal shortages, more frequent crop losses in exporting countries and shipping scares make imported protein dear and unreliable. Asian governments co-operate on approvals and invest in domestic protein. Vietnam makes more protein for people at home from its own carbohydrate and side streams: fermentation sugar from cassava, koji and fungal foods, and mung bean and rice protein, using shared pilot capacity.
where_vietnam_loses: Little: cost of capital and skills become the binding constraints
hubs_active_2050: All six candidate hubs, including the Mekong shrimp coast
early_signposts: Fishmeal above USD 2,500 per t for 12 months; two extreme El Nino events within a decade; joint maize losses above 10% in two major exporters in one year; war-risk insurance suspended on a main shipping lane
what_vietnam_decides: Whether plants, hubs and finance are ready when prices turn; late movers import Chinese or Thai capacity instead

name: Squeezed importer
name_vi: Nhà nhập khẩu bị chèn ép
picture_2050: Imported protein is dear and unreliable, and Chinese producers, with scale and state backing, capture most of the regional market for microbial and fermented protein. Domestic production survives where local feedstock or freshness give an edge, or where the state treats capacity as strategic.
soybean_meal_need_2050_mt_indicative: 7.0 to 10.4 (efficiency carries most of the reduction)
where_vietnam_loses: Precision fermentation, tolling for export, cultivated seafood
hubs_active_2050: Mekong river belt; Tay Ninh (selling sugar); Ho Chi Minh City with Dong Nai (small)
grows_from_2035_scenario: 2035 Scenario 1 under stress, or Scenario 2 with state support
early_signposts: Chronic-stress signposts of Scenario C together with the Chinese-dominance signposts of Scenario B; an export-dumping episode for microbial protein
what_vietnam_decides: How much security premium the state will pay, and whether efficiency gains arrive in time
